newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU inflation unchanged at 2.3 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: EU inflation unchanged at 2.3 pct in September.

text.p: Inflation in the European Union remained in September at the new record low it reached in August, rising at an annualised rate of 2.3 percent, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office said on Thursday.
"Thus is for the second month the lowest inflation since Eurostat began compiling these figures in 1983 for what are now the present 15 member states," Eurostat said in a statement.
In September last year inflation stood at 3.2 percent.

Nine countries out of the 15-nation bloc registered inflation rates at or below 2.0 percent, with Sweden showing the smallest price rise of 0.2 percent while Greece put in the worst performance with inflation advancing at a rate of 8.5 percent.
"All the southern member states remained above the EU average," Eurostat noted.
